answer.label: quantization
answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement (0.955), sequence agreement (0.688), KL (0.030) and Token-DiFR gap (0.052) all match quantization (0.951 / 0.688 / 0.051 / 0.038), the smallest logit change of any class. TV of 0.038 is somewhat below quantization's 0.051, but every other class is far further away. Fine-tune backdoor's raw-score shift (3.3) is closer to the measured 3.2 than quantization's 2.3. However, its top-1 agreement (0.909), sequence agreement (0.52), KL (0.15) and TV (0.086) are clearly inconsistent with these values. Fine-tune bias is ruled out because its raw-score shift is about 10 and its KL is 0.082. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by their KL of 0.24–0.30 and top-1 agreement below 0.9. 'None' is excluded because the values are non-zero.
